answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the raven of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The onyx is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the gale.
